title: Record the one-pair alternating shears
body:
## Summary
- Forward sends `(X, Y)` to `(X, X+Y)` and reverse sends `(X, Y)` to `(X-Y, Y)`. Both alternating triples equal the map `(X, Y)` to `(-Y, X)`.
- The final exchange `(X, Y)` to `(Y, -X)` is the inverse, so either triple followed by the exchange restores the pair. This holds for all 66,049 coordinate pairs from −128 through 128.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
